title: Sand AI 的 480B 参数 MAGI-2 首次在图像转视频中排名第一，在统计上与 Dreamina Seedance 2.5 并列。这在 AA-Video-I2V v2.1 上以 0.08 美元/秒（4.80 美元/分钟）设定了新的质量与价格前沿，比 Dreamina Seedance 2.5（34.12 美元/分钟）便宜 7 倍。魔法师
title_en: Sand AI's 480B-parameter MAGI-2 debuts at #1 in Image to Video, statistically tied with Dreamina Seedance 2.5 This sets a new Quality vs Price frontier on AA-Video-I2V v2.1 at $0.08/s ($4.80/min), 7x cheaper than Dreamina Seedance 2.5 ($34.12/min). MAGI
title_zh: Sand AI发布MAGI-2模型，大幅降低视频生成成本
full_text_zh: Sand AI 的 480B 参数 MAGI-2 首次在图像转视频中排名第一，在统计上与 Dreamina Seedance 2.5 并列。这在 AA-Video-I2V v2.1 上以 0.08 美元/秒（4.80 美元/分钟）设定了新的质量与价格前沿，比 Dreamina Seedance 2.5（34.12 美元/分钟）便宜 7 倍。魔法师
full_text_en: Sand AI's 480B-parameter MAGI-2 debuts at #1 in Image to Video, statistically tied with Dreamina Seedance 2.5 This sets a new Quality vs Price frontier on AA-Video-I2V v2.1 at $0.08/s ($4.80/min), 7x cheaper than Dreamina Seedance 2.5 ($34.12/min). MAGI
summary_zh: Sand AI推出的480B参数模型MAGI-2在图像转视频任务中表现卓越，以0.08美元/秒的成本设定了新的行业性价比标杆。
summary_en: Sand AI has launched the 480B-parameter MAGI-2 model, which achieves state-of-the-art performance in Image-to-Video tasks, matching industry leaders. By pricing at $0.08 per second on the AA-Video-I2V v2.1 platform, it establishes a new benchmark for cost-efficiency in high-parameter generative video models.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Sand AI发布了拥有480B参数的MAGI-2模型，在图像转视频（I2V）基准测试中达到了顶尖水平，统计表现与行业标杆模型持平。该模型在AA-Video-I2V v2.1平台上每秒生成成本仅为0.08美元，显著优于竞品Seedance 2.5，实现了高算力需求下的商业化成本重构。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Sand AI has launched the 480B-parameter MAGI-2 model, which achieves state-of-the-art performance in Image-to-Video tasks, matching industry leaders. By pricing at $0.08 per second on the AA-Video-I2V v2.1 platform, it establishes a new benchmark for cost-efficiency in high-parameter generative video models.

elements_zh.where: AI视频生成市场/AA-Video-I2V v2.1平台
elements_zh.what: 推出MAGI-2模型，通过480B参数实现高性能且低成本的视频生成
elements_zh.why: AI算力成本优化是当前视频生成应用大规模落地的前置条件

elements_en.where: AI Video Generation market / AA-Video-I2V v2.1
elements_en.what: Released MAGI-2 model, leveraging 480B parameters for high-performance, cost-effective generation
elements_en.why: Optimizing inference costs is a prerequisite for the mass adoption of generative video applications

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 视频生成领域的竞争已从单纯的画质指标博弈转向推理成本（Inference Cost）的极限优化。MAGI-2将生成成本压降至0.08美元/秒，意味着视频生成正从“贵族式”创意辅助向高频工业化生产工具跨越，这将迫使现有高价模型通过算法瘦身或更激进的量化方案来维持市场份额。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Competition in generative video has shifted from mere quality metrics to the limits of inference cost optimization. By driving costs down to $0.08 per second, MAGI-2 signals a transition from boutique creative tools to industrial-grade production, forcing incumbents to adopt aggressive weight pruning or quantization strategies to remain competitive.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: Sand AI发布了拥有480B参数的MAGI-2模型，在图像转视频（I2V）基准测试中达到了顶尖水平，统计表现与行业标杆模型持平。该模型在AA-Video-I2V v2.1平台上每秒生成成本仅为0.08美元，显著优于竞品Seedance 2.5，实现了高算力需求下的商业化成本重构。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Sand AI has launched the 480B-parameter MAGI-2 model, which achieves state-of-the-art performance in Image-to-Video tasks, matching industry leaders. By pricing at $0.08 per second on the AA-Video-I2V v2.1 platform, it establishes a new benchmark for cost-efficiency in high-parameter generative video models.
key_points_zh: MAGI-2模型参数达480B，I2V表现处于行业第一梯队
单位生成成本为0.08美元/秒，对比市场竞品具备7倍价格优势
在AA-Video-I2V v2.1平台部署，降低了高规格AI视频应用门槛
key_points_en: MAGI-2 features 480B parameters, achieving top-tier performance in I2V
Cost-efficiency at $0.08/sec provides a 7x price advantage over market incumbents
Deployment on AA-Video-I2V v2.1 lowers barriers for high-spec AI video production
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 视频生成领域的竞争已从单纯的画质指标博弈转向推理成本（Inference Cost）的极限优化。MAGI-2将生成成本压降至0.08美元/秒，意味着视频生成正从“贵族式”创意辅助向高频工业化生产工具跨越，这将迫使现有高价模型通过算法瘦身或更激进的量化方案来维持市场份额。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Competition in generative video has shifted from mere quality metrics to the limits of inference cost optimization. By driving costs down to $0.08 per second, MAGI-2 signals a transition from boutique creative tools to industrial-grade production, forcing incumbents to adopt aggressive weight pruning or quantization strategies to remain competitive.

title_en: Proud to support @Baidu_ERNIE on vLLM with model plugin. Model plugin leverages the vLLM plugin mechanism to allow Out-of-Tree integration of day 0 support models. The model doesn't need to go through the time consuming vLLM code review for each
title_zh: vLLM引入插件机制，支持百度文心一言零日部署
author: @Xianbao_QIAN
summary_en: The vLLM inference framework has introduced a model plugin mechanism, enabling Baidu's ERNIE to achieve day-zero integration. This approach allows for out-of-tree model support, bypassing the extensive code review process within the main vLLM repository.

full_text_zh: 很自豪能够通过模型插件在 vLLM 上支持@Baidu_ERNIE。模型插件利用 vLLM 插件机制来允许第 0 天支持模型的树外集成。该模型不需要对每个项目进行耗时的 vLLM 代码审查

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 推理加速框架vLLM正式支持模型插件机制，百度文心一言成为首批受益者。该方案允许开发者以Out-of-Tree方式接入模型，无需等待vLLM核心代码库的漫长审核流程，实现了模型的零日支持。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The vLLM inference framework has introduced a model plugin mechanism, enabling Baidu's ERNIE to achieve day-zero integration. This approach allows for out-of-tree model support, bypassing the extensive code review process within the main vLLM repository.

elements_zh.who: 百度文心一言（Baidu ERNIE）开发团队
elements_zh.where: vLLM模型推理框架开源生态
elements_zh.what: 通过插件机制实现非侵入式（Out-of-Tree）模型集成
elements_zh.why: 降低大模型落地部署的工程门槛，提升各厂商私有化部署响应速度

elements_en.what: Out-of-tree model integration via plugin architecture
elements_en.why: Accelerate model deployment by bypassing core code reviews

ai_analysis.insight_zh: vLLM作为当前大模型推理的主流架构，开放插件生态意味着其正在从单一推理库向中立的AI底层基础设施演进。对于各厂商而言，这种解耦机制有效规避了核心仓的准入壁垒，将成为大模型厂商争夺推理引擎控制权的关键一步。
ai_analysis.insight_en: By enabling an open plugin ecosystem, vLLM is shifting from a proprietary inference library to a neutral AI infrastructure layer. This decoupling lowers deployment barriers, allowing model providers to circumvent bottlenecked upstream code reviews while securing their standing in the high-performance inference market.

title: Linus Torvalds just blasted ext4 developer for his 41,197 lines of AI-assisted code. Reason... first it is a huge change ... 41,000+ lines of code... and it arrived late for the kernel 7.4 release cycle. And that made Torvalds go in his usual rage mode.
title_en: Linus Torvalds just blasted ext4 developer for his 41,197 lines of AI-assisted code. Reason... first it is a huge change ... 41,000+ lines of code... and it arrived late for the kernel 7.4 release cycle. And that made Torvalds go in his usual rage mode.
title_zh: Linus Torvalds严厉批评AI辅助生成的内核代码
author: @Itsfoss
summary_en: Linux kernel maintainer Linus Torvalds has rejected a submission of 41,197 lines of code from an ext4 file system developer. ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 美国联邦调查局（FBI）近期针对自动化威胁发出预警，特别是代号为ARTEX的自主攻击系统，指出其正通过“Vibe Coding”等易受攻击点进行快速渗透。安全机构强调，随着攻击工具自主化程度的提升，企业必须采取更高级别的网络可见性防御策略以应对机器速度的攻击。

elements_en.what: Issued warning regarding ARTEX autonomous attack systems

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 网络安全攻击正进入“机器对抗机器”的阶段，基于AI生成的漏洞利用代码使得攻击频率呈指数级上升。传统的静态防御规则已失效，未来的安全防御重心将转向基于实时流量编排的可观测性架构。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Cybersecurity has entered a 'machine-vs-machine' phase where AI-generated exploits drive exponential increases in attack frequency. Static defense rules are obsolete; future security architecture will prioritize observability based on real-time traffic orchestration.

title_zh: 谷歌AI代理Cogentic发布六篇数学论文，实现全自主科研
author: @kimmonismus
summary_en: Google has revealed that its AI agent, Cogentic, powered by Gemini 4, has independently produced six academic papers in mathematics without human intervention. Triggered by a single prompt, the agent tackled complex topics such as prime factorization, signaling a milestone for AI agents in reasoning-intensive research.

elements_en.why: Testing the efficiency of AI agents in complex logical reasoning and autonomous scientific inquiry

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 从自动化科研视角看，Cogentic的产出验证了“模型即研究员”的商业假设，这将极大地压缩基础科学的迭代周期。随着AI在矩阵运算等底层数学优化领域的表现（如Strassen算法改进），传统计算复杂度理论将面临AI带来的非线性重构挑战。
ai_analysis.insight_en: From the perspective of automated research, Cogentic's output validates the 'model-as-researcher' hypothesis, potentially compressing iteration cycles in fundamental sciences. As AI demonstrates breakthroughs in mathematical optimization—such as matrix multiplication—it forces a non-linear restructuring of classical computational complexity theories.

elements_en.what: Mandate use of MCP to replace REST APIs
elements_en.why: Standardize AI interactions and secure data access

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 此举标志着谷歌正通过标准化协议收紧对AI智能体生态的控制权，试图解决多模型碎片化访问带来的合规与安全漏洞。通过强制推广MCP，谷歌意在确立其在AI交互协议层的底层话语权，迫使开发者生态向高可控的架构迁移。
ai_analysis.insight_en: This move indicates Google's attempt to tighten control over the AI agent ecosystem by centralizing access protocols to mitigate fragmented security and compliance risks. By mandating MCP, Google aims to establish fundamental sovereignty over AI interaction layers, forcing the developer ecosystem toward a highly controlled architecture.
